purpose: Deterministic cross-source reconciliation rules for environmental observations.
principle: Sources are aligned before comparison. The system never silently averages, overwrites, or upgrades a data class.

rules.temporal_alignment: Compare only observations whose timestamps satisfy the indicator-specific alignment window; record the actual temporal offset.
rules.spatial_alignment: Compare only observations whose coordinates/product footprint can be mapped to the same venue or explicitly defined spatial aggregation; record spatial method and separation.
rules.unit_normalization: Normalize units only through a versioned deterministic conversion; preserve original provider value and unit.
rules.methodology: Do not compare unlike quantities as if identical. Modelled concentration, satellite column quantity, direct station concentration, forecast precipitation, and gauge precipitation retain distinct data classes.
rules.source_disagreement: REVIEW_REQUIRED unless an indicator-specific tolerance rule has been explicitly approved.
rules.promotion: Reconciliation can produce ALIGNED or WITHIN_RULE, but cannot itself promote MODELLED, FORECAST or SATELLITE to OBSERVED.
